'''Idalowd'''<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> was a [[species]] of [[Sentience|sentient]] beings that were identified by their [[Color|purple]], puncture-proof skin. [[Countess]] [[Alissyndrex delga Cantonica Provincion]] was a member of the species.<ref name="TLJ VD" /> Another member attended a dinner party hosted by the [[Imperial Senate|Imperial Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] and her husband [[Perrin Fertha]] on [[Coruscant]]<ref name="Announcement">{{Andor|Announcement}}</ref> in [[5 BBY]].<ref name="Andor date">"[[Announcement]]" takes place shortly after "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," which dates itself to [[5 BBY]].</ref>
